title: Radioactive Bear Skull Biker
description: A skeletal bear wearing a gas mask and spiked leather biker jacket rides a customized chopper motorcycle across a barren wasteland. The figure glows with toxic green and purple radioactive energy, flames burn in its eyes, and green slime drips from its jaws against a neon sunset sky with aurora borealis.
prompt: A skeletal bear with glowing purple eyes and a gas mask rides a heavily customized chopper motorcycle through a post-apocalyptic desert at sunset. The bear wears a spiked black leather jacket with chains and patches, green toxic slime drips from its jaws and the bike. Vibrant green and purple radioactive flames and smoke surround the figure, with palm trees, ruined billboards and an aurora borealis in the pink and purple sky.
